title: Radio: Horton Field — RTK-2 has no fix

lines.text: Flight Ops, Crew 1 at Horton Field. RTK-2 still hasn’t got a fixed solution after fifteen minutes.
Has the hack got into the base station? Do we hold?

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 20s, uncertain, wind across the field

instructorNote: Red herring: a normal cold start. RTK-2 is not on the NAS.

snapshot.title: GCS-02 Offline — Field Tech Alert

lines.text: IT, this is J. Kline in the field. We’re setting up DAA-1 for the test at Birch Hollow Range. The weather’s good, but I just noticed the GCS-02 icon is offline on the AVS map. Is it down? Should we hold the test?
[Pause] We’re at 10.17.40.17—same as GCS-02. But it’s not responding to pings. I don’t see it on the network. Is it on a different VLAN?

fields.voiceStyle: Male, mid-30s, calm but tense, slight background wind and radio static

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the infection has severed GCS-02 from the network. The technical team must now trace the loss to the NAS or GCS compromise, not a network policy change.
